detail.longDescription: **media[1256876]**Partnership brings together DXC's decades of experience operating mission-critical enterprise systems with LangChain's technology for safely and securely managing AI agent harnessesDXC OASIS, built on LangChain's open-source LangGraph runtime, is scaling toward 125 customer environments across regulated industries and multiple geographiesAcross 500 measured use cases, OASIS has reduced resolution time by 95% on average, with diagnostic accuracy of 92% or betterASHBURN, Va., Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC), a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner, today announced a partnership with LangChain, the company behind the open-source LangGraph agent framework and LangSmith agent engineering platform, to advance governed agentic AI across mission-critical enterprise IT environments. The partnership builds on DXC's use of LangGraph within DXC OASIS, its intelligent orchestration platform and operating model for mission-critical IT operations. DXC is also licensing LangSmith to support the development, evaluation, and observability of OASIS agents. OASIS is already in production and scaling toward 125 customer environments across regulated industries and multiple geographies. Together, these capabilities help DXC build, orchestrate, evaluate, and continuously improve AI agents while applying the enterprise context, governance, human oversight, and continuous assurance required for critical technology environments.
